buffer_name.description: Equilibration / loading buffer composition as entered in eLabFTW.

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the loading isotherm experiment.

process_run_id.description: Identifier for the automated process run as stored in eLabFTW extra fields.

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting used during loading / equilibration (numerical part if given).

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition on the plate.

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand whose loading is quantified.

total_volume_ul.description: Total liquid volume used per well in the loading isotherm.

pump_duration_s.description: Duration for which the pump is running during loading / equilibration.

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time for the loading isotherm step.

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the experiment (parsed from semicolon- or comma-separated string).

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles applied before loading.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used in the loading isotherm (parsed from semicolon- or comma-separated string).

incubation_temperature_c.description: Incubation temperature for the loading step.

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength of the plate reader.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit for salt concentrations, e.g. mM.

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution (numeric part).

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations, e.g. µM or mM.

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution (numeric part).

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

equilibration_cycle_duration_s.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle.

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations loaded on the plate.

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations loaded on the plate.

analysis_status.description: Status of the analysis as reported by the analysis script.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were collected into the database.

summary.description: High-level summary metrics from Langmuir isotherm fits.

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of ligand concentrations used in the experiment.

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of salt concentrations used in the experiment.

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition.

num_warnings.description: Number of warning messages generated during analysis.

analysis_metadata.description: Full metadata block embedded by the analysis script (parsed experimental parameters).

warnings.description: List of warning strings generated during analysis.

data_files.description: Output data file names / paths from the analysis script.

plots.description: Plot files generated by the analysis script.

raw_analysis_output.description: Raw JSON object loaded from the analysis_results_*.json file.
